audit.whatIsWrong: The missingInteractions entry (Pyke's Gift of the Drowned Ones bypasses stacked HP, punishing raw armour/health itemization) is not stated anywhere on the page.

edits.before: Life Form Disintegration online — rooted duos meet the beam's thesis.
edits.after: Pyke's R lands at 6: an execute threshold plus kill resets means one Q-pull or E-stun chains into a burst you can't out-range.

edits.before: First item: rotations delete and the fork angles multiply.
edits.after: First item Pyke snowballs: W camouflage flanks and R resets punish greedy poke harder than your combo punishes his roams.

edits.before: Q-fork the pair, W the pulse, third-hit the research — true math their page can't answer.
edits.after: If he lands Bone Skewer and dives, your E knockup interrupts his follow-through — trade the peel for tempo, not damage.

edits.before: Beaming into a loaded engage — the channel is a verdict for fights already decided.
edits.after: Channeling your R while Pyke has Q and E both up hands him a free stun-into-execute on you — bank the beam until his tools are down.

edits.before: - Pyke Bone Skewer: matchup-defining — The hook starts the chain — his R cleans what it catches. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your E Tectonic Disruption answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Bone Skewer (Q) is 10-8s early — the hook starts the chain; his R cleans what it catches. Read it before every duo step-up. - Gift of the Drowned Ones ignores stacked HP, armour alone won't answer it. - His R is 100/85/70s; spend yours on swing moments only.

edits.before: World Atlas start. Mandate or Liandry's-lite lines, Sorcerer's, then Rylai's-Zhonya's paths. Add anti-heal early into his duo’s sustain.
edits.after: World Atlas start. Mandate or Liandry's-lite lines, Sorcerer's, then Rylai's-Zhonya's paths. Gift of the Drowned Ones bypasses stacked HP, so favor MR and utility over raw health. Add anti-heal early into his duo’s sustain.
